name: bg-animated-gradient
title: Animated Gradient
blurb: Radial gradients pulse and shift position in a continuous cycle.
description: Animates multiple radial gradients with configurable colors and positions. Uses motion/react to smoothly transition gradient positions with infinite reverse repeat.
use_when: Section needing animated gradient background with custom colors and durations.
avoid_when: Browsers without animation support, or minimal-motion user preferences.
a11y: Purely decorative animation; no interaction or accessibility controls.
